bounded_progress_design.periodic_records: Append a small progress record after every256 completed hash rows and every256 completed replay rows, plus all stage boundaries. Include monotonic_ns, completed/new-old row counters, current ordinal and endpoint, and phase-local cumulative durations. A start record is never a success record.
bounded_progress_design.journal_behavior: Create-new, bounded JSONL, flush each small progress record, no fsync/powerloss promise. Never emit raw API payloads. Journal failure makes the audit unknown; complete lines surviving a kill only attest progress, not whole verification.
bounded_progress_design.large_decode_visibility: Persist compressed-read/decode start and end separately. A single json.loads call has no internal progress certificate; if killed there the last start only identifies that bounded stage. Do not infer decoding progress from elapsed time.
bounded_progress_design.cost: All journal, hash, decode, comparison, replay, export and cleanup costs belong to the same fixed600s attempt and the external complete Python launch-to-exit wall. No subtraction or budget extension.
